question: List the names of all customers from Tunisia, ordered alphabetically by name.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country = 'Tunisia' ORDER BY name;

question: What is the price of the product named 'Dune'?
gold_sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE name = 'Dune';

question: List all product names that are currently out of stock, ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE in_stock = 0 ORDER BY name;

question: List the 5 most expensive products with their prices, from most to least expensive.
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List all order IDs with status 'cancelled', ordered by order ID.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' ORDER BY order_id;

question: What are the names of all categories, in alphabetical order?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM categories ORDER BY name;

question: List the names of customers who signed up in 2023, ordered by signup date.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY signup_date;

question: List all order IDs placed in March 2024, ordered by order date.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31' ORDER BY order_date;

question: How many products are currently in stock?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE in_stock = 1;

question: List the names of customers based in London, ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'London' ORDER BY name;

question: What is the average price of all products, rounded to 2 decimal places?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM products;

question: How many orders have status 'pending'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending';

question: What is the name of the most expensive product that is currently out of stock?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE in_stock = 0 ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many customers signed up in each year? Show year and count, ordered by year.
gold_sql: SELECT substr(signup_date, 1, 4) AS year, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question: What percentage of orders have status 'completed'? Round to 1 decimal place.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM orders;

question: List all product names in the 'Electronics' category, ordered by price descending.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics' ORDER BY p.price DESC;

question: How many products are there in each category? Show category name and count, ordered by category name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name;

question: What is the average price of products in each category? Show category name and average price rounded to 2 decimals, ordered by average price descending.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_price DESC;

question: List the names of customers who have never placed an order, ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.name;

question: How many orders has each customer placed? Show customer name and order count, ordered by order count descending, then by name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n_orders DESC, c.name;

question: List the names of products in the 'Books' category that cost less than 20, ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Books' AND p.price < 20 ORDER BY p.name;

question: What is the total quantity of 'Yoga Mat' units sold across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Yoga Mat';

question: How many orders are there for each status? Show status and count, ordered by status name.
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

question: What is the total revenue (quantity times unit price) from all order items, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) FROM order_items;

question: List the names of customers from 'France' who signed up before 2023-06-01, ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country = 'France' AND signup_date < '2023-06-01' ORDER BY name;

question: List the 5 products with the highest total quantity sold, showing product name and total quantity.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List the distinct names of customers who placed at least one 'cancelled' order, ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' ORDER BY c.name;

question: List the names of products that have never appeared in any order, ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_item_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.name;

question: List the top 3 customers by number of orders placed, showing name and order count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2024? Show month as YYYY-MM and count, ordered by month.
gold_sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: List the names of customers and the date of their most recent order, for customers who have placed at least one order, ordered by most recent order date descending.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY last_order DESC;

question: List the names of categories that have more than 5 products, with the product count, ordered by count descending.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY n DESC;

question: List the names of products that cost more than the average product price, ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) ORDER BY name;

question: List the names of products priced within 10% of the most expensive product in the store, ordered by price descending.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price >= 0.9 * (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products) ORDER BY price DESC;

question: How many distinct products has the customer 'James Smith' ordered?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'James Smith';

question: List the top 5 customers by total revenue (quantity times unit price) from completed orders, showing name and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List the distinct names of customers who have ordered the product 'Ergonomic Chair', ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Ergonomic Chair' ORDER BY c.name;

question: List the names of customers who have placed 5 or more orders, with their order count, ordered by order count descending then name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY n DESC, c.name;

question: List the names of categories that have no products priced above 100, ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM categories cat WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p WHERE p.category_id = cat.category_id AND p.price > 100) ORDER BY name;

question: For each category, what is the name and price of its most expensive product? Show category name, product name, and price, ordered by category name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, p.name AS product, p.price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.price = (SELECT MAX(p2.price) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id) ORDER BY c.name;

question: What is the total revenue (quantity times unit price) from completed orders only, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed';

question: Which 3 countries generated the most total revenue from completed orders? Show country and revenue rounded to 2 decimals, ordered by revenue descending.
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3;

question: List the names of customers whose number of orders is above the average number of orders per customer, counting only customers with at least one order, ordered by name.
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN counts ct ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id WHERE ct.n > (SELECT AVG(n) FROM counts) ORDER BY c.name;

question: List the 5 products that generated the most total revenue (quantity times unit price), showing product name and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which customers have spent more than 300 in total on completed orders? Show name and total spent rounded to 2 decimals, ordered by total spent descending.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.name HAVING total_spent > 300 ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: For each category, how many distinct customers have bought at least one product from it? Show category name and customer count, ordered by customer count descending then category name.
gold_sql: SELECT cat.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS n_customers FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY n_customers DESC, cat.name;

question: List the names of customers who have ordered products from at least 3 different categories, with the category count, ordered by category count descending then name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) AS n_categories FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING n_categories >= 3 ORDER BY n_categories DESC, c.name;

question: What is the name of the product that generated the single highest revenue (quantity times unit price) from a single order item row?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY oi.quantity * oi.unit_price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List the names of customers who have never ordered a product from the 'Electronics' category, ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE cat.name = 'Electronics') ORDER BY c.name;

question: What is the average order value (sum of quantity times unit price per order), rounded to 2 decimals, considering only completed orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id);
